sourceVerification.method: SELECT-only JDBC transaction, connection read-only, rolled back; no application started against production
sourceVerification.ledgerInventoryCaveat: Inventory includes other supplier scopes and all receipts; it is not the canonical period revenue KPI.
sourceVerification.rootCause: 76 unique operational bookings versus 1 source booking gives (76-1)/1*100 = 7500%. Arithmetic was correct; low-base context and elapsed-period alignment were missing. Frontend presentation aggregation also erased all comparisons and mixed cumulative users with period registrations.

serviceValuePreservation: Persisted presentation history and amounts are unchanged. completedServiceValue remains a separate current-status snapshot of COMPLETED bookings created in the selected range, not period revenue/completion events; no unsupported historical comparison.
testsVersusSource: 1->76, 100->120/80, zero/negative transitions, rates, precise monetary arithmetic and date-edge inputs are isolated test fixtures. Operational 76/1 was independently verified with source SQL, not inferred from the UI percentage.

validation.mysql: Production MySQL 9.7 SELECT-only reconciliation passed. Local MySQL integration/migration suite not run: no isolated MySQL/Docker; 8 optional tests skipped. This is not a claim that the new API was executed against production.
validation.schemaLimit: Each Booking references exactly one ServiceOffering. Tests cover different service IDs, multiple supplier children/review targets and payment retries without count multiplication; there is no multi-service-per-booking workflow in this schema.
validation.api: ADMIN authorization retained; customer/supplier/staff rejected; explicit null/comparison statuses and both period bounds serialized; canonical receipts, refund gross policy, period cutoffs, cohort counts and chart reconciliation tested.
validation.browser: Real Spring/JWT/API/H2 flow, not mocked admin responses: desktop/mobile 1920,1440,1366,1024,768,390,360 px passed; SPA filters, DAY/WEEK/MONTH, no horizontal overflow, no page errors or API 5xx; auth revocation/logout and scoped financial reads passed.
validation.productionAdminSession: Not used to validate the new UI/API; not deployed. Financial baseline comes from read-only source queries, not browser fixtures.

deployment: Not deployed by this implementation task. Coordinate releases: stage the frontend contract guard before enabling the new backend contract, or switch both together. Legacy aliases retain null for unknown history (older clients assumed non-null); the new frontend fails safely while an older backend is still serving.
integrity: No genuine or synthetic production business records, PayOS identifiers/receipts/signatures, audit rows or backups were modified. Only read-only production SELECTs were executed. Local H2 test fixtures are disposable.
